name: Antananarivo
description: Madagascar's capital city, built across twelve hills in the central highlands at an altitude of around 1,400 metres. Known to residents as Tana, it is a city of extraordinary light — clear and sharp at altitude, with views across a basin of rice paddies to the surrounding hills. Its architecture layers French colonial buildings over older Merina settlements; its streets hold that layering visibly. For Malagasy cinema, Antananarivo has been both subject and backdrop: a city in permanent transition, carrying its histories in plain sight.
